四级核心词汇 · 12英文原文

A Medal for the Whole Relay

属于整支接力队的奖牌 · 595 词 · 9 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1Ivo, an ambitious amateur runner, trained at a municipal stadium. He could dominate a short dash. His coach entered him in a relay contest. Ivo wanted to earn an individual medal. His rival had won three successive races and liked to boast about his strength. Ivo thought a slow teammate would spoil his chance. He barely greeted the runner who would receive his baton.

2Sana kept a badge from her first marathon. She lacked his speed, but she could keep a steady rhythm when her muscles ached. In a vigorous trial, Ivo threw the baton as if passing a ball. It struck her elbow and fell outside the lane. He blamed her for reacting too late. A veteran athlete asked both to demonstrate what they had expected. Sana showed how she bent her wrist as Ivo approached.

3Sana reached back at a constant angle. Ivo had expected her to turn. The coach asked them to settle on one call and practice at a moderate pace. She marked the transfer zone with chalk. Ivo found the routine tedious. He liked the intense effort of a fast lap. It took more discipline to make a simple movement consistent than it took to run once at full speed.

4The coach did not scold Ivo for his aggressive start. At maximum speed the movement would be tough to control. She asked them to swing their arms gently and stretch. A buddy called the exercise a waste of time. Ivo understood his preference for a race, but now a clean exchange gave him pleasure too. He could endure the slower practice and still have the vigor for another lap.

5At the next competition, a fierce wind swept across the oval track. An opponent slipped. The tension showed in one runner's clenched fists. Sana tapped Ivo's wrist to refresh his memory. He was tense, but he heard the call. The baton changed hands without either runner breaking stride. Once he had passed it, Ivo could relax his shoulders and watch her finish.

6The team came second. Ivo felt miserable and tried to hide his frustration. Sana grinned and showed him their time. They had gained almost a second in the transfer zone. The coach praised their perseverance and asked what had changed their motivation. They had learned to tolerate an awkward exercise and persevere when the result was hard to perceive. For Ivo, that was more remarkable than a fast practice lap.

7A reporter asked if Ivo still wanted to compete in the individual category. He did. He felt envy when a peer joined an elite league. He could pursue that ambition with enthusiasm and treat his teammates as partners. A more balanced training plan would let him run alone and also motivate a younger athlete. His considerate attitude made him more tolerant of criticism.

8A keen pupil had been too pessimistic to participate in practice. Ivo invited him to try one exchange with no time limit. The pupil made a fuss when the baton fell. Ivo had once lost his temper in the same situation. He showed the pupil where to look, then waited. A clean exchange gave both of them a reason to return the next day.

9After their first medal, the pupil asked who had made the victory possible. Ivo put the medal down and picked up the baton. He asked the pupil to hold out a hand. It was too tight at first. Ivo waited, gave the call, and placed the baton in his palm. That simple movement, he thought, was the ultimate lesson of their triumph.

四级核心词汇 · 12中文译文

属于整支接力队的奖牌

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1有抱负的业余跑者伊沃在市体育场训练。短距离冲刺时，他常能占上风。教练却给他报了接力赛。伊沃本想拿一枚个人奖牌。他的对手已经连赢三场，还喜欢夸耀自己的实力。伊沃担心队友慢会耽误自己，几乎没跟要接他棒的人打招呼。

2萨娜留着第一次跑马拉松时的徽章。她没有伊沃快，肌肉开始酸痛时，仍然能保持稳定的节奏。一次高强度试跑中，伊沃像传球那样把接力棒扔了出去。棒子打中萨娜的手肘，掉到跑道外。伊沃怪她反应慢。一位老运动员请两人演示，他们分别以为对方会怎么做。萨娜示范了伊沃跑过来时，她怎样弯手腕。

3萨娜总以同一个角度把手往后伸，伊沃原来却在等她转身。教练让他们先定一个口令，以适中的速度练习，又用粉笔标出交接区。伊沃觉得这套练习枯燥，他更喜欢用力跑一圈的感觉。要把一个简单动作每次都做稳，其实比全速跑一次更需要自律。

4教练没有因为伊沃起步太猛就训他。速度一到最高，动作会很难控制。她请他们轻轻摆臂，再做拉伸。有个伙伴说，这练习纯粹浪费时间。伊沃明白对方为什么更想直接跑一场，但现在顺利交棒也会让他高兴。他能坚持做完慢练习，还有余力再跑一圈。

5下一场比赛，强风扫过椭圆形跑道。一名对手滑倒了。一个跑者攥着拳头，一看就很紧张。萨娜轻轻碰了碰伊沃的手腕，提醒他记起约定。伊沃紧绷着，却听清了口令。两人都没有打乱步子，接力棒就顺利换了手。交出棒后，伊沃放松肩膀，看着萨娜跑到终点。

6队里拿了第二。伊沃心里难受，试着藏起挫败感。萨娜咧嘴一笑，把用时给他看。他们在交接区赢回了近一秒。教练肯定了他们的坚持，也问是什么让他们愿意继续。两个人学会了忍受别扭的练习，在一时看不出结果时也接着做。对伊沃来说，这比练习时跑快一圈更值得记住。

7记者问，伊沃还想不想参加个人项目。他当然想。看到一位同龄选手进了高水平联赛，他曾很羡慕。现在他可以继续热情地追求自己的目标，也把队友当伙伴。把训练安排得均衡些，他能练单项，也能鼓励年纪更小的跑者。他更懂得体谅别人，也更能听得进批评。

8有个很想尝试的学生太悲观，一直没敢参加练习。伊沃邀请他先交一次棒，不限时间。棒子一掉，学生就急了。伊沃以前碰到同样的事也发过脾气。他只指给学生看该往哪儿看，然后等他准备好。一次顺利交棒，让两个人都有了第二天再来的理由。

9队里拿到第一枚奖牌后，那名学生问，是谁让这场胜利成为可能。伊沃放下奖牌，拿起接力棒，让学生伸出手。那只手一开始绷得太紧。伊沃等了一下，喊出口令，把接力棒放进他手心。他想，这个简单的动作，就是那次成功给他们最重要的一课。
